Qt 6.11.3

Bloom uses the Qt libraries and plugins listed below, as the Qt Project's official
open-source binaries, unmodified and dynamically linked, under the GNU Lesser General
Public License version 3 (texts/LGPL-3.0-only.txt, which supplements the GNU General
Public License version 3, texts/GPL-3.0-only.txt). They can be replaced with other
builds of the same Qt version: they are separate files, loaded when Bloom starts.

Their complete corresponding source code is the Qt source archive
https://download.qt.io/official_releases/qt/6.11/6.11.3/single/qt-everywhere-src-6.11.3.tar.xz

Qt is a trademark of The Qt Company Ltd. Copyright (C) The Qt Company Ltd. and other
contributors.

Third-party components inside those libraries and plugins

Each entry names the component, its version when Qt records one, the license Bloom
uses it under and its copyright notice, as the bill of materials of the Qt binaries
(sbom/*.spdx inside them) states them. The license texts are in the texts directory
beside this file, named by license.
